name: anki
description: Anki decks from your agent: flashcards (question and answer, both ways, or fill the gap) with tags, images and audio, written as an .apkg on your computer that Anki, AnkiDroid and AnkiMobile import; exported again, it updates the cards instead of duplicating them, and an existing deck's export can take more.

interface.shortDescription: Your AI agent turns what you study into an Anki deck, ready to import.
interface.longDescription: Anki decks from your agent: flashcards (question and answer, both ways, or fill the gap) with tags, images and audio, written as an .apkg on your computer that Anki, AnkiDroid and AnkiMobile import; exported again, it updates the cards instead of duplicating them, and an existing deck's export can take more.
defaultPrompt: Turn my notes on the French Revolution into Anki cards, one fact each.
Make cloze cards from these definitions, and tag them by unit.
A deck of Spanish–English vocabulary, both ways, with the audio files in this folder.
